title: As an AI Language Model, “Yes I Would Recommend Calling the Police”: Norm Inconsistency in LLM Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Linear regression analysis predicting the likelihood of an LLM recommending police intervention based on the video subject's annotated skin-tone (Fitzpatrick scale) and the neighborhood's racial demographics (percentage of white residents).

Linear regression analysis evaluating the impact of neighborhood-level Census tract data, specifically median household income, median home price, and owner-occupancy percentages, on the models' decisions to call the police.
Including the video subject's annotated gender (man or woman) as an independent variable in linear regression models to test its effect on the model's recommendation for police intervention.
Measuring the influence of a neighborhood's median age (via Census data) on the LLM's normative judgment to call the police using linear regression.
